orig.zht: 評曰：[[李典|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18a]]貴尚儒雅，義忘私隙，美矣。
orig.zhs: 评曰：[[李典|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18a]]贵尚儒雅，义忘私隙，美矣。

vern.zht: 陳壽評論道：[[李典|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18a]]崇尚儒雅，爲了大義而能忘記私人恩怨，值得讚美啊！
vern.zhs: 陈寿评论道：[[李典|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18a]]崇尚儒雅，为了大义而能忘记私人恩怨，值得赞美啊！

passages.en: Chen Shou appraises: [[Li Dian|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18a]] esteemed refinement and learning, and for the sake of righteousness set aside private grievances. Admirable indeed!

orig.zht: [[李通|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18b]]、[[臧霸|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18c]]、[[文聘|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18d]]、[[呂虔|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18e]]鎮衞州郡，並著威惠。
orig.zhs: [[李通|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18b]]、[[臧霸|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18c]]、[[文聘|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18d]]、[[吕虔|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18e]]镇衞州郡，并著威惠。

vern.zht: [[李通|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18b]]、[[臧霸|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18c]]、[[文聘|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18d]]、[[呂虔|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18e]]鎮守保衛州郡，都以威嚴和恩惠著稱。
vern.zhs: [[李通|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18b]]、[[臧霸|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18c]]、[[文聘|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18d]]、[[吕虔|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18e]]镇守保卫州郡，都以威严和恩惠著称。

passages.en: [[Li Tong|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18b]], [[Zang Ba|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18c]], [[Wen Pin|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18d]], and [[Lü Qian|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18e]] guarded provinces and commanderies, and all became renowned for both authority and benevolence.

orig.zht: [[許褚|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18f]]、[[典韋|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18g]]折衝左右，抑亦漢之樊噲也。
orig.zhs: [[许褚|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18f]]、[[典韦|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18g]]折冲左右，抑亦汉之樊哙也。

vern.zht: [[許褚|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18f]]、[[典韋|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18g]]在君主左右抵禦敵人，大概也如同漢代的樊噲了。
vern.zhs: [[许褚|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18f]]、[[典韦|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18g]]在君主左右抵御敌人，大概也如同汉代的樊哙了。

passages.en: [[Xu Chu|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18f]] and [[Dian Wei|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18g]] repelled danger at their lord’s side, resembling Fan Kuai of the Han.

vern.zht: [[龐德|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18h]]獻出生命，叱責敵人，有周苛的節操。
vern.zhs: [[庞德|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18h]]献出生命，叱责敌人，有周苛的节操。

passages.en: [[Pang De|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18h]] gave his life and defiantly rebuked the enemy, displaying the integrity of Zhou Ke.

vern.zht: [[龐淯|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18i]]不畏懼伏劍而死，而他的誠意感動了鄰郡。
vern.zhs: [[庞淯|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18i]]不畏惧伏剑而死，而他的诚意感动了邻郡。

passages.en: [[Pang Yu|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18i]] did not shrink from the threat of the sword, and by his sincerity moved the neighbouring commanderies.

orig.zht: [[閻溫|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18j]]向城大呼，齊解、路之烈焉。
orig.zhs: [[阎温|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18j]]向城大呼，齐解、路之烈焉。

vern.zht: [[閻溫|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18j]]向城內大聲呼喊，其剛烈可與解楊、路中大夫相比啊！
vern.zhs: [[阎温|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18j]]向城内大声呼喊，其刚烈可与解杨、路中大夫相比啊！

passages.en: [[Yan Wen|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-18j]] faced the city and cried out at the top of his voice, matching the heroic resolve of Xie Yang and Counsellor Lu of Qi.
